notablePrerequisites: The number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than 5 plus Elenda's commander tax.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W}.
Choose to return Elenda from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Elenda dies, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Elenda.
Cast Elenda from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Repeat.
